english_text: I am 65 years old and I have been living with HIV for 20 years.
sesotho_text: Ke na le lilemo tse 65 mme ke phela le HIV ka lilemo tse 20.

english_text: I have HIV and I have also been diagnosed with diabetes.
sesotho_text: Ke na le HIV mme ke boetse ke fuoe bolwetse ba tsoekere.

english_text: I have HIV and high blood pressure and I take many medicines every day.
sesotho_text: Ke na le HIV le khatello e phahameng ea mali mme ke nka meriana e mengata letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: I want to join a support group for people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Ke batla ho kenela sehlopha sa tshehetso bakeng sa batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: I have been living with HIV for two years and I have not told anyone.
sesotho_text: Ke phela le HIV ka lilemo tse peli mme ha ke eso bolelle motho.

english_text: Directly observed therapy can help people who struggle with ART adherence.
sesotho_text: Phekolo e shebilloeng ka kotloloho e ka thusa batho ba tobanang le mathata a ho latela ART.

english_text: Mobile phone reminders and SMS messages can improve ART adherence.
sesotho_text: Litemoso tsa mohala le melaetsa ea SMS li ka ntlafatsa ho latela ART.

english_text: Adherence clubs bring together groups of stable HIV patients to collect medicines together.
sesotho_text: Maklabo a ho latela a koahanya lihlopha tsa bakuli ba HIV ba tsitsitseng ho kgotha meriana hammoho.

english_text: Adherence counselling should be provided at every clinic visit not just at initiation.
sesotho_text: Keletso ea ho latela e lokela ho fanoa letsetsong le leng le le leng la kliniki eseng ho qala feela.

english_text: Identifying and addressing barriers to adherence improves treatment outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho tseba le ho sebetsana le meqoqo ea ho latela ho ntlafatsa liphetho tsa phekolo.

english_text: Poverty, transport costs, and work commitments are common barriers to ART adherence.
sesotho_text: Bofuma, litšenyehelo tsa lipalangoa, le boikarabello ba mosebetsi ke meqoqo e tloaelehileng ea ho latela ART.

english_text: Stigma and fear of disclosure are significant barriers to ART adherence.
sesotho_text: Kekello le tšabo ea ho senola ke meqoqo e bohlokoa ea ho latela ART.

english_text: Side effects are one of the most common reasons people stop taking ART.
sesotho_text: Litlamorao tsa moriana ke e 'ngoe ea mabaka a atileng ka ho fetisisa ao batho ba emang ho nka ART.

english_text: Switching to a better-tolerated ART regimen can improve adherence.
sesotho_text: Ho fetohela lenanong la ART le mamelloang hantle ho ka ntlafatsa ho latela.

english_text: Peer support from other people living with HIV significantly improves ART adherence.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso ea bahlankana ho tsoa ho batho ba bang ba phelang le HIV e ntlafatsa ho latela ART haholo.

english_text: Task-shifting allows trained community health workers to support HIV care delivery.
sesotho_text: Ho fetisetsa mesebetsi e fapaneng ho lumella basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle ba sechaba ba koetlisitsoeng ho tshehetsa ho fana ka tlhokomelo ea HIV.

english_text: Nurse-initiated ART has expanded access to treatment in under-resourced settings.
sesotho_text: ART e qalilloeng ke baoki e atolositsa phihlello ea phekolo libakeng tse hlokang mehloli.

english_text: Decentralisation of HIV services brings care closer to communities.
sesotho_text: Ho abeloa ha litshebeletso tsa HIV ho tlisa tlhokomelo haufi le sechaba.

english_text: Point-of-care viral load testing reduces delays in identifying treatment failure.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha viral load sebakeng sa tlhokomelo ho fokotsa ho lieha ha ho tseba ho hloleha ha phekolo.

english_text: Digital health tools including telemedicine can support HIV care in remote areas.
sesotho_text: Lisebelisoa tsa bophelo bo botle tsa dijithale ho kenyelletsa telemedicine li ka tshehetsa tlhokomelo ea HIV libakeng tse hole.

english_text: HIV programme data should be disaggregated by age, sex, and population group.
sesotho_text: Data ea lenaneo la HIV e lokela ho aroloa ka lilemo, bong, le sehlopha sa sechaba.

english_text: Quality improvement initiatives in HIV clinics lead to better patient outcomes.
sesotho_text: Meketso ea ntlafatso ea boleng likhlinikhing tsa HIV e lebisa liphetho tse ntle tsa bakuli.

english_text: Patient satisfaction surveys help identify gaps in HIV service delivery.
sesotho_text: Lipatlisiso tsa khotsofalo ea bakuli li thusa ho tseba maqeba ho faneng ka litshebeletso tsa HIV.

english_text: HIV national strategic plans guide the response at country level.
sesotho_text: Maano a naha a leano la HIV a etelela karabelo maemong a naha.

english_text: Multi-sectoral collaboration is essential for an effective national HIV response.
sesotho_text: Tšebelisano ea likarolo tse ngata e bohlokoa bakeng sa karabelo ea naha ea HIV e sebetsang.

english_text: I have been undetectable for three years and I feel like myself again.
sesotho_text: Ke bile le viral load e sa fumaneheng ka lilemo tse tharo mme ke ikutloa ke le nna hape.

english_text: I want to tell my story to help other people living with HIV feel less alone.
sesotho_text: Ke batla ho bolela pale ea ka ho thusa batho ba bang ba phelang le HIV hore ba ikutloe ba se mong hanyane.

english_text: I did not think I would live this long after my HIV diagnosis but here I am.
sesotho_text: Ha ke a nahana hore nka phela nako e telele joalo ka mor'a ho fuoa HIV empa ke le mona.

english_text: My children do not know I have HIV and I am not sure when to tell them.
sesotho_text: Bana ba ka ha ba tsebe hore ke na le HIV mme ha ke tsebe nako eo ke tla ba bolella ka eona.

english_text: I have been healthy on ART for ten years and I still come to the clinic every three months.
sesotho_text: Ke phela hantle holim'a ART ka lilemo tse leshome mme ke ntse ke tla klinikhing likhoeli tse tharo le tse tharo.

english_text: I want to know more about the new long-acting HIV injection so I do not have to take pills every day.
sesotho_text: Ke batla ho tseba haholoanyane ka ente e ncha ea HIV e sebetsang nako e telele hore ke se ke nke lipilisi letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: I am a nurse and I have HIV and I still care for patients every day.
sesotho_text: Ke mooki mme ke na le HIV empa ke ntse ke hlokomela bakuli letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: I was diagnosed with HIV at birth and I am now 18 years old and doing well.
sesotho_text: Ke fuoe HIV ha ke tsoa tsoaloa mme joale ke na le lilemo tse 18 mme ke phela hantle.

english_text: I want to help other young people living with HIV in my community.
sesotho_text: Ke batla ho thusa bacha ba bang ba phelang le HIV sechabeng sa ka.

english_text: HIV has taught me to take care of my health and I am grateful for the treatment that keeps me alive.
sesotho_text: HIV e nthutile ho hlokomela bophelo ba ka mme ke leboha phekolo e npolokang ke phela.

english_text: ART should be initiated on the same day as HIV diagnosis whenever possible.
sesotho_text: ART e lokela ho qaloa letsatsi le leng la ho fuoa HIV neng kapa neng ha ho khoneha.

english_text: Same-day ART initiation improves early retention in HIV care.
sesotho_text: Ho qala ART letsatsi le leng le ho fuoa HIV ho ntlafatsa ho lula tlhokomelong ea HIV kapele.

english_text: Readiness assessment before ART initiation helps identify potential adherence barriers.
sesotho_text: Ho lekola boitokisetso pele ho qala ART ho thusa ho tseba meqoqo e ka khonehang ea ho latela.

english_text: Patients who understand why they take ART are more likely to adhere to treatment.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba utloisisang hore na ba nkang ART ke hobaneng ba na le monyetla o moholo oa ho latela phekolo.

english_text: Health literacy is an important factor in ART adherence.
sesotho_text: Ho tseba ho bala le ho ngola ha bophelo bo botle ke ntlha e bohlokoa ho latela ART.

english_text: Simplified ART regimens with fewer pills improve adherence.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a ART a bonolo a nang le lipilisi tse fokolang a ntlafatsa ho latela.

english_text: Once-daily ART regimens are preferred because they are easier to remember.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a ART a nkuoang habeli ka letsatsi a khahloa hobane a bonolo ho hopola.

english_text: Food requirements for ART medicines vary and patients should be counselled accordingly.
sesotho_text: Litlhoko tsa lijo bakeng sa meriana ea ART li fapana mme bakuli ba lokela ho fuoa keletso ka ho latela.

english_text: Some ART medicines must be taken with food while others can be taken on an empty stomach.
sesotho_text: Meriana e meng ea ART e lokela ho nkoa le lijo ha e meng e ka nkoa ka mala a se nang lijo.

english_text: ART medicine storage requirements should be explained to every patient at initiation.
sesotho_text: Litlhoko tsa ho boloka meriana ea ART li lokela ho hlalossoa mokuloi e mong le e mong ha a qala.

english_text: Most ART medicines should be stored at room temperature away from heat and moisture.
sesotho_text: Meriana e mengata ea ART e lokela ho bolokoa mocheso oa kamora ntle le mocheso le mongobo.

english_text: Patients should be given a treatment literacy session before starting ART.
sesotho_text: Bakuli ba lokela ho fuoa sehloho sa ho tseba phekolo pele ho qala ART.

english_text: Treatment literacy helps patients understand HIV, ART, and the importance of adherence.
sesotho_text: Ho tseba phekolo ho thusa bakuli ho utloisisa HIV, ART, le bohlokoa ba ho latela.

english_text: Adherence to ART must be above 95 percent to maintain viral suppression.
sesotho_text: Ho latela ART ho lokela ho feta pesente ea 95 ho boloka ho laoloa ha vaerase.

english_text: Even one or two missed doses per month can reduce the effectiveness of ART.
sesotho_text: Le ho lahleheloa ke dose e le 'ngoe kapa tse peli ka khoeli ho ka fokotsa bokgoni ba ART.

english_text: Viral load testing should be repeated every twelve months for stable patients on ART.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha viral load ho lokela ho phindoa likhoeli tse leshome le metso e meli le metso e meli bakeng sa bakuli ba tsitsitseng holim'a ART.

english_text: A viral load above 1000 copies per millilitre after six months on ART indicates treatment failure.
sesotho_text: Viral load e fetang likopi tse sekete ka millilitre ka mor'a likhoeli tse tšeletseng holim'a ART e bontša ho hloleha ha phekolo.

english_text: Enhanced adherence counselling should be provided before switching ART regimens.
sesotho_text: Keletso e ntlafatsoeng ea ho latela e lokela ho fanoa pele ho fetohela mananeo a mang a ART.

english_text: Three sessions of enhanced adherence counselling are recommended before declaring treatment failure.
sesotho_text: Lithupelo tse tharo tsa keletso e ntlafatsoeng ea ho latela li khothalletsoa pele ho phatlalatsa ho hloleha ha phekolo.

english_text: A repeat viral load test should be done three months after enhanced adherence counselling.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea viral load e phindilloeng e lokela ho etsoa likhoeli tse tharo ka mor'a keletso e ntlafatsoeng ea ho latela.

english_text: CD4 count testing is less important once a patient is virally suppressed on ART.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha palo ea CD4 ho bohlokoa hanyane ha mokuloi a se a laoloa ke vaerase holim'a ART.

english_text: CD4 count testing remains important for patients presenting with advanced HIV disease.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha palo ea CD4 ho ntse ho bohlokoa bakeng sa bakuli ba bontšang bolwetse ba HIV bo tsoelang pele.

english_text: Point-of-care CD4 testing allows results to be available on the same day.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha CD4 sebakeng sa tlhokomelo ho lumella hore liphetho li fumanehe letsatsi le leng.

english_text: Dried blood spot samples can be used for viral load testing in remote areas.
sesotho_text: Lisampole tsa madi a omisitsoeng li ka sebelisoa ho lekoa ha viral load libakeng tse hole.

english_text: Viral load suppression rates are a key indicator of HIV programme performance.
sesotho_text: Likhato tsa ho laoloa ha viral load ke sesupo se bohlokoa sa tšebetso ea lenaneo la HIV.

english_text: Tenofovir can cause kidney damage and bone loss with long-term use.
sesotho_text: Tenofovir e ka baka kotsi ea lipitso le ho lahleheloa ha masapo ka tšebediso ea nako e telele.

english_text: Tenofovir alafenamide has fewer kidney and bone side effects than tenofovir disoproxil fumarate.
sesotho_text: Tenofovir alafenamide e na le litlamorao tse fokolang tsa lipitso le masapo ho feta tenofovir disoproxil fumarate.

english_text: Dolutegravir can cause weight gain in some patients.
sesotho_text: Dolutegravir e ka baka ho eketseha ha boima ho bakuli ba bang.

english_text: Dolutegravir should be used with caution in women of childbearing age due to neural tube defect risk.
sesotho_text: Dolutegravir e lokela ho sebelisoa ka hloko ho basali ba lilemo tsa ho tsoa le bana ka lebaka la kotsi ea bothata ba neural tube.

english_text: Efavirenz should be taken at bedtime to minimise neuropsychiatric side effects.
sesotho_text: Efavirenz e lokela ho nkoa nako ea ho robala ho fokotsa litlamorao tsa neuropsychiatric.

english_text: Nevirapine can cause a severe skin rash and liver toxicity especially in the first few weeks.
sesotho_text: Nevirapine e ka baka ho ruruha ha letlalo ho matla le kotsi ea sebete haholo libekeng tsa pele tse itseng.

english_text: Zidovudine can cause anaemia and bone marrow suppression.
sesotho_text: Zidovudine e ka baka anaemia le ho laoloa ha bone marrow.

english_text: Stavudine is no longer recommended due to serious long-term side effects.
sesotho_text: Stavudine ha e sa khothalletsoa ka lebaka la litlamorao tse matla tsa nako e telele.

english_text: Lopinavir/ritonavir can cause diarrhoea, nausea, and elevated cholesterol.
sesotho_text: Lopinavir/ritonavir e ka baka sehlohlolo, ho nyakeloa, le ho phahama ha cholesterol.

english_text: Ritonavir is used as a pharmacokinetic booster to increase levels of other protease inhibitors.
sesotho_text: Ritonavir e sebelisoa e le moqhosi oa pharmacokinetic ho eketsa maemo a li-protease inhibitor tse ling.

english_text: Voluntary medical male circumcision reduces the risk of female-to-male HIV transmission by 60 percent.
sesotho_text: Ho ritoa ha banna ka boithatelo ho fokotsa kotsi ea phetisetso ea HIV ho tsoa ho basali ho ea ho banna ka pesente ea 60.

english_text: VMMC is recommended as part of a comprehensive HIV prevention package in high-prevalence settings.
sesotho_text: VMMC e khothalletsoa e le karolo ea sephutho se pharalletseng sa thibelo ea HIV libakeng tse nang le palo e phahameng.

english_text: VMMC does not protect against HIV transmission from men to women.
sesotho_text: VMMC ha e sireletse khahlanong le phetisetso ea HIV ho tsoa ho banna ho ea ho basali.

english_text: Oral PrEP using tenofovir and emtricitabine is highly effective when taken daily.
sesotho_text: PrEP ea molomo e sebelisang tenofovir le emtricitabine e sebetsa hantle haholo ha e nkoa letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: Cabotegravir long-acting injectable PrEP is given every two months.
sesotho_text: PrEP ea Cabotegravir e kenngoa ka mesipi e sebetsang nako e telele e neoang likhoeli tse peli le tse peli.

english_text: Dapivirine vaginal ring is a PrEP option for women that releases medicine slowly over one month.
sesotho_text: Sephaphe sa dapivirine sa sebaka sa thobalano ke khetho ea PrEP bakeng sa basali se lokollang moriana butle ka khoeli e le ngoe.

english_text: PrEP should be combined with regular HIV testing and STI screening.
sesotho_text: PrEP e lokela ho kopanyoa le liteko tsa kamehla tsa HIV le ho hlahlobeloa ha mafu a fetisoang ka thobalano.

english_text: PrEP is safe and does not cause HIV resistance if a person tests negative before starting.
sesotho_text: PrEP e bolokehile mme ha e bake khakanyo ea HIV haeba motho a hlahlobelitsoe mme a fumana sephetho se senyenyane pele ho qala.

english_text: People can stop and restart PrEP based on their risk level.
sesotho_text: Batho ba ka emisa le ho qala hape PrEP ho latela boemo ba bona ba kotsi.

english_text: On-demand PrEP involves taking doses before and after sex rather than daily.
sesotho_text: PrEP ea on-demand e kenyelletsa ho nka li-dose pele le ka mora thobalano ho feta ho nka letsatsi le leng le le leng.

english_text: PEP must be taken for exactly 28 days and must not be stopped early.
sesotho_text: PEP e lokela ho nkoa ka matsatsi a 28 ka nepo mme ha e lokela ho emisoa kapele.

english_text: PEP is not 100 percent effective and should not replace regular prevention methods.
sesotho_text: PEP ha e sebetse ka pesente ea 100 mme ha e lokela ho nka sebaka sa mekhoa ea kamehla ea thibelo.

english_text: Blood safety programmes ensure that all donated blood is tested for HIV before transfusion.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a polokeho ea mali a netefatsa hore mali ohle a fanoeng a hlahlobeloa HIV pele ho fetisetsoang.

english_text: Universal precautions protect healthcare workers and patients from HIV transmission.
sesotho_text: Liqabelo tsa bohle li sireletsa basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle le bakuli ho phetisetso ea HIV.

english_text: Sterile injection equipment should always be used to prevent HIV transmission.
sesotho_text: Lisebelisoa tsa ho kenya ka mesipi tse hloekileng li lokela ho sebelisoa kamehla ho thibela phetisetso ea HIV.

english_text: All HIV-exposed infants should receive daily nevirapine for six weeks after birth.
sesotho_text: Bana bohle ba hlahisitsoeng HIV ba lokela ho fumana nevirapine letsatsi le leng le le leng ka libeke tse tšeletseng ka mor'a ho tsoaloa.

english_text: High-risk HIV-exposed infants should receive dual prophylaxis with nevirapine and zidovudine.
sesotho_text: Bana ba hlahisitsoeng HIV ba leng kotsing e kholo ba lokela ho fumana prophylaxis ea bobeli ea nevirapine le zidovudine.

english_text: HIV-exposed infants should be given cotrimoxazole prophylaxis from six weeks of age.
sesotho_text: Bana ba hlahisitsoeng HIV ba lokela ho fuoa prophylaxis ea cotrimoxazole ho qala libeke tse tšeletseng tsa lilemo.

english_text: Cotrimoxazole prophylaxis in HIV-exposed infants can be stopped after a negative HIV test at 18 months.
sesotho_text: Prophylaxis ea cotrimoxazole ho bana ba hlahisitsoeng HIV e ka emisoa ka mor'a tlhahlobo ea HIV e senyenyane ka likhoeli tse 18.

english_text: HIV-exposed infants who are breastfeeding should be tested for HIV at every immunisation visit.
sesotho_text: Bana ba hlahisitsoeng HIV ba anyesioang ba lokela ho hlahlobeloa HIV letsetsong le leng le le leng la ente.

english_text: HIV-positive mothers should be supported to disclose their status to their partners.
sesotho_text: Bomme ba nang le HIV ba lokela ho tsheheltsoa ho senola boemo ba bona ho balekane ba bona.

english_text: Partner testing should be offered to all male partners of HIV-positive pregnant women.
sesotho_text: Ho hlahlobeloa ha molekane ho lokela ho fanooa ho banna bohle ba basali ba mitsi ba nang le HIV.

english_text: HIV-negative pregnant women with HIV-positive partners should be offered PrEP.
sesotho_text: Basali ba mitsi ba se nang HIV ba nang le balekane ba nang le HIV ba lokela ho fanooa PrEP.

english_text: Retention in PMTCT care throughout pregnancy and the postnatal period is critical.
sesotho_text: Ho lula tlhokomelong ea PMTCT ho pholletsa le ho ima le nako ea ka mor'a tsoalo ho bohlokoa haholo.

english_text: Loss to follow-up in PMTCT programmes puts both mothers and babies at risk.
sesotho_text: Ho lahlehela ho latela mananeo a PMTCT ho beha bomme le bana kotsing.

english_text: Community health workers can trace mothers who miss PMTCT appointments.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba bophelo bo botle ba sechaba ba ka batla bomme ba lahlehetseng meeto ea PMTCT.

english_text: Integrating PMTCT with maternal and child health services improves uptake.
sesotho_text: Ho kopanya PMTCT le litshebeletso tsa bophelo bo botle ba bomme le bana ho ntlafatsa ho amoheloa.

english_text: Peer mother support programmes improve PMTCT outcomes.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a tshehetso ea bomme ba bahlankana a ntlafatsa liphetho tsa PMTCT.

english_text: The elimination of mother-to-child transmission of HIV is a global health target.
sesotho_text: Ho felisoa ha phetisetso ea HIV ho tsoa ho mme ho ea ho ngoana ke sepheo sa bophelo bo botle sa lefatše lohle.

english_text: Countries can achieve EMTCT validation when transmission rates fall below two percent.
sesotho_text: Linaha li ka fihlela netefatso ea EMTCT ha likhato tsa phetisetso li theohela tlase ho pesente tse peli.

english_text: Cotrimoxazole prophylaxis should be started in all people with CD4 counts below 350.
sesotho_text: Prophylaxis ea cotrimoxazole e lokela ho qaloa ho batho bohle ba nang le palo ea CD4 e tlase ho 350.

english_text: Cotrimoxazole prophylaxis can be stopped once CD4 count rises above 350 on ART.
sesotho_text: Prophylaxis ea cotrimoxazole e ka emisoa ha palo ea CD4 e phahama ho feta 350 holim'a ART.

english_text: Isoniazid preventive therapy and cotrimoxazole should be given together in people with advanced HIV.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea thibelo ea isoniazid le cotrimoxazole li lokela ho fanoa hammoho ho batho ba nang le HIV e tsoelang pele.

english_text: Fungal infections of the skin and nails are common in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Litšoaetso tsa fungal tsa letlalo le lenala li atile ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Herpes zoster or shingles is more common and more severe in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Herpes zoster kapa shingles e atile haholo ebile e matla ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Acyclovir is used to treat herpes zoster in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Acyclovir e sebelisoa ho phekola herpes zoster ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Recurrent bacterial pneumonia is an AIDS-defining illness.
sesotho_text: Pneumonia ea bakteria e phindang e phindang ke bolwetse bo hlalositsoeng ke AIDS.

english_text: Salmonella bacteraemia is more common and more severe in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Salmonella bacteraemia e atile haholo ebile e matla ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Microsporidiosis causes chronic diarrhoea in people with advanced HIV.
sesotho_text: Microsporidiosis e baka sehlohlolo sa nako e telele ho batho ba nang le HIV e tsoelang pele.

english_text: Penicilliosis is an important opportunistic infection in people with HIV in Southeast Asia.
sesotho_text: Penicilliosis ke tšoaetso e bohlokoa ea monyetla ho batho ba nang le HIV Asia ea Boroa-bochabela.

english_text: Histoplasmosis is an opportunistic fungal infection that affects people with low CD4 counts.
sesotho_text: Histoplasmosis ke tšoaetso ea fungal ea monyetla e angoa batho ba nang le palo e tlase ea CD4.

english_text: Immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome usually occurs within the first three months of ART.
sesotho_text: Syndrome ea ho bola ha tšireletso ea 'mele hangata e etsahala ka likhoeli tse tharo tsa pele tsa ART.

english_text: Mild IRIS can be managed by continuing ART and treating the underlying infection.
sesotho_text: IRIS e bonolo e ka laoloa ka ho tsoela pele ART le ho phekola tšoaetso e ka tlaase.

english_text: Severe IRIS may require corticosteroid treatment.
sesotho_text: IRIS e matla e ka hloka phekolo ea corticosteroid.

english_text: IRIS does not mean ART is failing and treatment should not be stopped.
sesotho_text: IRIS ha e bolele hore ART e hloleha mme phekolo ha e lokela ho emisoa.

english_text: The W4SS symptom screen for TB includes cough, fever, night sweats, and weight loss.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea W4SS ea matšoao a TB e kenyelletsa ho kohoa, feberu, molapo oa bosiu, le ho lahleheloa ke boima.

english_text: A negative W4SS screen in a person living with HIV indicates low risk of active TB.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea W4SS e senyenyane ho motho ea phelang le HIV e bontša kotsi e tlase ea TB e sebetsang.

english_text: CRP testing can be added to TB screening in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha CRP ho ka eketsooa ho hlahlobeloa ha TB ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Chest X-ray is an important tool for TB screening in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: X-ray ea sefuba ke sesebelisoa se bohlokoa sa ho hlahlobeloa ha TB ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: GeneXpert MTB/RIF is a rapid molecular test that diagnoses TB and detects rifampicin resistance.
sesotho_text: GeneXpert MTB/RIF ke tlhahlobo ea molecular e potlakileng e fumanang TB le ho fumana khakanyo ea rifampicin.

english_text: GeneXpert should be used as the first-line TB diagnostic test in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: GeneXpert e lokela ho sebelisoa e le tlhahlobo ea pele ea TB ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Urine lipoarabinomannan testing can diagnose TB in people with advanced HIV disease.
sesotho_text: Ho lekoa ha lipoarabinomannan ea moroto ho ka fumana TB ho batho ba nang le bolwetse ba HIV bo tsoelang pele.

english_text: TB preventive therapy with isoniazid and rifapentine for one month is as effective as six months of isoniazid.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea thibelo ea TB ka isoniazid le rifapentine ka khoeli e le ngoe e sebetsa joaloka likhoeli tse tšeletseng tsa isoniazid.

english_text: TB preventive therapy should be given to all household contacts of TB patients who are HIV-positive.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea thibelo ea TB e lokela ho fanoa ho batho bohle ba kopanang le bakuli ba TB ba nang le HIV malapa.

english_text: People with HIV who have completed TB treatment should receive TB preventive therapy.
sesotho_text: Batho ba nang le HIV ba phethelang phekolo ea TB ba lokela ho fumana phekolo ea thibelo ea TB.

english_text: Harm reduction services for people who inject drugs include needle exchange and opioid substitution.
sesotho_text: Litshebeletso tsa ho fokotsa kotsi bakeng sa batho ba kenyang meriana ka mesipi li kenyelletsa phapano ea mesipi le ho nka sebaka sa opioid.

english_text: Harm reduction does not increase drug use and is an evidence-based HIV prevention strategy.
sesotho_text: Ho fokotsa kotsi ha ho eketse tšebediso ea meriana mme ke leano la thibelo ea HIV le thehiloeng holim'a bopaki.

english_text: Methadone and buprenorphine are opioid substitution therapies that reduce injecting and HIV risk.
sesotho_text: Methadone le buprenorphine ke diphekolo tsa ho nka sebaka sa opioid tse fokotsa ho kenya ka mesipi le kotsi ea HIV.

english_text: Drop-in centres provide HIV services to key populations in a safe and non-judgmental environment.
sesotho_text: Lisentare tsa ho kenela li fana ka litshebeletso tsa HIV ho sechaba se bohlokoa tikolohong e bolokehileng e sa ahloleng.

english_text: Outreach workers are essential for delivering HIV services to hard-to-reach populations.
sesotho_text: Basebetsi ba phono ba bohlokoa ho fana ka litshebeletso tsa HIV ho sechaba se thata ho fihlela.

english_text: Self-testing kits can be distributed to key populations through outreach programmes.
sesotho_text: Lisebelisoa tsa ho itlhahlobeloa li ka abela sechaba se bohlokoa ka mananeo a phono.

english_text: HIV services for sex workers should include STI screening, contraception, and violence support.
sesotho_text: Litshebeletso tsa HIV bakeng sa basebetsi ba thobalano li lokela ho kenyelletsa ho hlahlobeloa ha mafu a fetisoang ka thobalano, thibelo ea ho ima, le tshehetso ea tlhoriso.

english_text: Decriminalisation of sex work is associated with reduced HIV risk and better health outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho tlosa molato mosebetsing oa thobalano ho amahanngoa le ho fokotsa kotsi ea HIV le liphetho tse ntle tsa bophelo bo botle.

english_text: Gay and bisexual men face unique social and structural barriers to HIV care.
sesotho_text: Banna ba ratanang le banna le ba bisexual ba tobana le meqoqo e ikhethileng ea sechaba le ea sebopeho ho tlhokomelong ea HIV.

english_text: Chemsex or the use of drugs during sex increases HIV risk among men who have sex with men.
sesotho_text: Chemsex kapa tšebediso ea meriana nakong ea thobalano e eketsa kotsi ea HIV ho banna ba robetsanang le banna.

english_text: Young women aged 15 to 24 are twice as likely to acquire HIV as young men of the same age.
sesotho_text: Basali ba bacha ba lilemo tse 15 ho isa ho 24 ba na le monyetla o habeli ho fumana HIV ho feta banna ba bacha ba lilemo tse tšoanang.

english_text: Transactional sex increases HIV risk among young women in sub-Saharan Africa.
sesotho_text: Thobalano ea khoebo e eketsa kotsi ea HIV ho basali ba bacha Afrika e ka tlase ho Sahara.

english_text: Age-disparate relationships between older men and younger women drive HIV transmission.
sesotho_text: Likamano tse fapaneng ka lilemo lipakeng tsa banna ba baholo le basali ba bacha li khothaletsa phetisetso ea HIV.

english_text: Cash transfer programmes for adolescent girls reduce HIV risk.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a ho fetisetsa chelete bakeng sa banana ba bacha a fokotsa kotsi ea HIV.

english_text: Keeping girls in school reduces their vulnerability to HIV.
sesotho_text: Ho boloka banana sekolong ho fokotsa bokoa ba bona ho HIV.

english_text: Menstrual hygiene management is linked to sexual health and HIV risk in adolescent girls.
sesotho_text: Taolo ea bohloeki ba khoeli e amahanngoa le bophelo bo botle ba thobalano le kotsi ea HIV ho banana ba bacha.

english_text: Women in polygamous relationships face increased HIV risk.
sesotho_text: Basali ba likamano tsa linyaloaneng ba tobana le kotsi e eketsehileng ea HIV.

english_text: Widows and widowers may be at increased HIV risk after losing a partner to HIV.
sesotho_text: Bahlolohadi ba ka ba kotsing e eketsehileng ea HIV ka mor'a ho lahleheloa ke molekane ke HIV.

english_text: Male circumcision programmes should include HIV counselling and testing for female partners.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a ho ritoa ha banna a lokela ho kenyelletsa keletso ea HIV le liteko bakeng sa balekane ba basali.

english_text: Engaging men as allies in gender equality reduces HIV risk for women and girls.
sesotho_text: Ho kenyelletsa banna e le balekane ho lekaneng ha bong ho fokotsa kotsi ea HIV bakeng sa basali le banana.

english_text: HIV diagnosis can trigger grief, anger, denial, and fear that require professional support.
sesotho_text: Ho fuoa HIV ho ka baka maswabi, bohale, ho hana, le tšabo tse hlokang tshehetso ea boqhetseke.

english_text: The stages of adjustment to HIV diagnosis include shock, denial, anger, bargaining, and acceptance.
sesotho_text: Maemo a ho ikamahanya le ho fuoa HIV a kenyelletsa ho tšosoa, ho hana, bohale, ho phehisana, le ho amohela.

english_text: Motivational interviewing is an effective counselling approach for improving ART adherence.
sesotho_text: Lipotso tsa khothaletso ke mokoa oa keletso o sebetsang ho ntlafatsa ho latela ART.

english_text: Problem-solving therapy helps people living with HIV address practical barriers to care.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea ho rarolla mathata e thusa batho ba phelang le HIV ho sebetsana le meqoqo ea pratiki ea tlhokomelo.

english_text: Group therapy for people living with HIV reduces depression and improves quality of life.
sesotho_text: Phekolo ea sehlopha bakeng sa batho ba phelang le HIV e fokotsa ho nyamela le ho ntlafatsa boleng ba bophelo.

english_text: HIV-related stigma internalisation is associated with depression and poor treatment outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho amohela kekello e amanang le HIV ho amahanngoa le ho nyamela le liphetho tse mpe tsa phekolo.

english_text: Resilience-building programmes help people living with HIV cope with adversity.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a ho aha botsitso a thusa batho ba phelang le HIV ho mamella mathata.

english_text: Social support from family and friends is a protective factor for mental health in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso ea sechaba ho tsoa ho lelapa le metsoalle ke ntlha ea tšireletso ea bophelo ba kelello ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Disclosure of HIV status to a supportive person is associated with better mental health outcomes.
sesotho_text: Ho senola boemo ba HIV ho motho ea tshehelang ho amahanngoa le liphetho tse ntle tsa bophelo ba kelello.

english_text: HIV-positive people who are employed report better mental health and quality of life.
sesotho_text: Batho ba nang le HIV ba sebetsang ba bua ka bophelo bo botle ba kelello le boleng ba bophelo bo ntlafetseng.

english_text: Wasting in people living with HIV is defined as involuntary weight loss of more than ten percent.
sesotho_text: Ho fofela ha batho ba phelang le HIV ho hlalossoa e le ho lahleheloa ha boima ka ho se ikemisele ho feta leshome la pesente.

english_text: Nutritional assessment should be done at every HIV clinic visit.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea phepo e lokela ho etsoa letsetsong le leng le le leng la kliniki ea HIV.

english_text: Body mass index should be measured regularly in people living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Body mass index e lokela ho lekoloa ka mehla ho batho ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Mid-upper arm circumference is used to assess nutritional status in children living with HIV.
sesotho_text: Bophara ba bohareng ba lephaka le holimo bo sebelisoa ho lekola boemo ba phepo ho bana ba phelang le HIV.

english_text: Appetite stimulants may be needed for people living with HIV who have severe weight loss.
sesotho_text: Lisebelisoa tsa ho khothaletsa takatso ea lijo li ka hlokeha bakeng sa batho ba phelang le HIV ba nang le ho lahleheloa ha boima ho matla.

english_text: Nausea from ART can be managed by eating small frequent meals.
sesotho_text: Ho nyakeloa ho tsoang ho ART ho ka laoloa ka ho ja lijo tse nyenyane ka mehla.

english_text: Diarrhoea caused by ART or opportunistic infections increases nutritional requirements.
sesotho_text: Sehlohlolo se bakoang ke ART kapa litšoaetso tsa monyetla se eketsa litlhoko tsa phepo.

english_text: Oral nutritional supplements can help people living with HIV meet their energy needs.
sesotho_text: Lisebelisoa tsa phepo tsa molomo li ka thusa batho ba phelang le HIV ho fihlela litlhoko tsa bona tsa matla.

english_text: Breastfeeding mothers living with HIV have increased nutritional needs.
sesotho_text: Bomme ba anyesang ba phelang le HIV ba na le litlhoko tse eketsehileng tsa phepo.

english_text: Community gardens and food production programmes support nutrition in HIV-affected households.
sesotho_text: Lipolase tsa sechaba le mananeo a tlhahiso ea lijo a tshehetsa phepo malapa a angoa ke HIV.

english_text: The Berlin patient was the first person to be functionally cured of HIV through a bone marrow transplant.
sesotho_text: Mokuloi oa Berlin e ne e le motho oa pele ho folisoa HIV ka ho fetisetsoa ha bone marrow.

english_text: Several people have achieved long-term HIV remission after stem cell transplants.
sesotho_text: Batho ba bang ba fihleletse ho khutlela morao ha HIV ha nako e telele ka mor'a ho fetisetsoa ha lisele tsa motheo.

english_text: Analytical treatment interruption studies help researchers understand HIV remission.
sesotho_text: Lipatlisiso tsa ho emisa phekolo ka tlhahlobo li thusa baithuti ho utloisisa ho khutlela morao ha HIV.

english_text: HIV latency reversing agents aim to flush the virus out of its reservoir.
sesotho_text: Lisebelisoa tsa ho fetola ho patala ha HIV li ikemiseditse ho leleka vaerase polokelong ea eona.

english_text: CRISPR gene editing technology is being explored as a potential HIV cure strategy.
sesotho_text: Theknoloji ea ho hlophisa gene ea CRISPR e hlahlojoa e le leano le ka khonehang la pholo ea HIV.

english_text: Therapeutic vaccines aim to boost the immune response to control HIV without ART.
sesotho_text: Liente tsa phekolo li ikemiseditse ho matlafatsa karabelo ea tšireletso ea 'mele ho laola HIV ntle le ART.

english_text: The RV144 trial showed that an HIV vaccine could provide modest protection.
sesotho_text: Tlhahlobo ea RV144 e bontšitse hore ente ea HIV e ka fana ka tšireletso e nyenyane.

english_text: mRNA vaccine technology used in COVID-19 vaccines is now being applied to HIV vaccine research.
sesotho_text: Theknoloji ea ente ea mRNA e sebelisitsoeng ho liente tsa COVID-19 joale e sebelisoa ho lipatlisiso tsa ente ea HIV.

english_text: Broadly neutralising antibodies can suppress HIV in people who stop ART.
sesotho_text: Li-antibody tse phanyolang ka bophara li ka laola HIV ho batho ba emang ART.

english_text: Passive immunisation with broadly neutralising antibodies is being studied as HIV prevention.
sesotho_text: Ho koahetsoa ka ho se sebetse ka li-antibody tse phanyolang ka bophara ho ithutoa e le thibelo ea HIV.

english_text: Integrated HIV and non-communicable disease services reduce patient burden.
sesotho_text: Litshebeletso tse kopaneng tsa HIV le mafu a sa fetisoang li fokotsa morwalo oa mokuloi.

english_text: HIV clinics can serve as entry points for hypertension and diabetes screening.
sesotho_text: Likhliniki tsa HIV li ka sebetsa e le menyako ea ho hlahlobeloa ha khatello e phahameng ea mali le tsoekere.

english_text: Supply chain management is critical to ensure uninterrupted ART supply.
sesotho_text: Taolo ea letoto la phano e bohlokoa ho netefatsa phano ea ART e sa emeng.

english_text: ART stockouts at health facilities lead to treatment interruptions and resistance.
sesotho_text: Ho fela ha ART likamoreng tsa bophelo bo botle ho lebisa ho emisa ha phekolo le khakanyo.

english_text: Community ART groups allow stable patients to collect medicines for each other.
sesotho_text: Lihlopha tsa ART tsa sechaba li lumella bakuli ba tsitsitseng ho kgotha meriana bakeng sa ba bang.

english_text: Facility-based adherence clubs reduce clinic congestion and improve patient satisfaction.
sesotho_text: Maklabo a ho latela a thehiloeng kamoreng a fokotsa mathata a kliniki le ho ntlafatsa khotsofalo ea bakuli.

english_text: Telemedicine consultations for stable HIV patients reduce the need for clinic visits.
sesotho_text: Lipuisano tsa telemedicine bakeng sa bakuli ba HIV ba tsitsitseng li fokotsa tlhoko ea ho etela kliniki.

english_text: HIV programme reviews should assess coverage, quality, and equity of services.
sesotho_text: Litlhahlobo tsa lenaneo la HIV li lokela ho lekola koahelo, boleng, le tekano ea litshebeletso.

english_text: Routine health information systems should capture HIV testing, treatment, and viral load data.
sesotho_text: Mekgwa ea kamehla ea tsebo ea bophelo bo botle e lokela ho tšoara data ea liteko tsa HIV, phekolo, le viral load.

english_text: Strengthening health systems is essential for a sustainable HIV response.
sesotho_text: Ho matlafatsa mekgwa ea bophelo bo botle ho bohlokoa bakeng sa karabelo ea HIV e tsoelang pele.

english_text: HIV-positive networks provide advocacy, peer support, and community mobilisation.
sesotho_text: Marang-rang a batho ba nang le HIV a fana ka boipiletso, tshehetso ea bahlankana, le ho matlafatsa sechaba.

english_text: The meaningful involvement of people living with HIV improves programme design and delivery.
sesotho_text: Ho kenyelletsooa ho nang le moelelo ha batho ba phelang le HIV ho ntlafatsa moralo le ho fana ka mananeo.

english_text: Community score cards allow communities to evaluate the quality of HIV services.
sesotho_text: Likarete tsa lintlha tsa sechaba li lumella sechaba ho lekola boleng ba litshebeletso tsa HIV.

english_text: HIV-affected households need social protection including food, housing, and income support.
sesotho_text: Malapa a angoa ke HIV a hloka tšireletso ea sechaba ho kenyelletsa lijo, ntlo, le tshehetso ea lekeno.

english_text: Orphans and vulnerable children affected by HIV need targeted support programmes.
sesotho_text: Bana ba mahlomola le ba bokoa ba angoa ke HIV ba hloka mananeo a tshehetso a lebisitsoeng.

english_text: HIV-affected children are at higher risk of school dropout, malnutrition, and abuse.
sesotho_text: Bana ba angoa ke HIV ba leng kotsing e phahameng ea ho tlohela sekolo, ho hloka phepo, le ho hlorisoa.

english_text: Psychosocial support for orphans and vulnerable children improves their wellbeing.
sesotho_text: Tshehetso ea psychosocial bakeng sa bana ba mahlomola le ba bokoa e ntlafatsa bophelo ba bona bo botle.

english_text: Community-based organisations provide home visits, food support, and school fees for OVC.
sesotho_text: Mekhatlo e thehiloeng sechabeng e fana ka litsebeliso tsa lapeng, tshehetso ea lijo, le lifee tsa sekolo bakeng sa OVC.

english_text: Grandmothers and other extended family members often care for children orphaned by HIV.
sesotho_text: Nkhono le maloko a mang a lelapa le leholo hangata a hlokomela bana ba hlokang batsoali ka lebaka la HIV.

english_text: Foster care and adoption programmes support children who have lost parents to HIV.
sesotho_text: Mananeo a tlhokomelo ea ho hlokomela le ho amohela bana a tshehetsa bana ba lahlehetseng ke batsoali ka lebaka la HIV.

english_text: I have been on ART for six months and my viral load is now undetectable.
sesotho_text: Ke holim'a ART ka likhoeli tse tšeletseng mme viral load ea ka joale ha e fumanehe.

english_text: I missed my clinic appointment because I could not afford the taxi fare.
sesotho_text: Ke lahlehetsoe ke moeto oa kliniki hobane ha ke a khona ho lefa lifee tsa tekesi.

english_text: I hide my HIV medicine in a different container so my family does not see it.
sesotho_text: Ke pata meriana ea HIV ea ka sengoteng se seng hore lelapa la ka le se e bone.

english_text: I take my HIV medicine at night so the side effects happen while I am sleeping.
sesotho_text: Ke nka meriana ea HIV ea ka bosiu hore litlamorao li etsahale ha ke robetse.

english_text: I am worried about gaining weight since I started the new HIV medicine.
sesotho_text: Ke na le khatello ea ho eketseha ha boima ho tloha ha ke qala moriana o mocha oa HIV.
